This plugin therefore declares an **open lower bou"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"nd** (`>=0.1.2-alpha.3`), which every runtime passes — a narrow `^`-range would be skipped as `skipp"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ing profile bundle` on each dsh minor release. Install through `dsh plugin … add` (pnpm-based): plai"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"n `npm install` answers `ERESOLVE`, because standard semver never matches a prerelease against an op"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"stall` answers `ERESOLVE`, because standard semver never matches a prerelease against an open range."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"If a dsh release renames a seam the plugin reads, the plugin degrades instead of breaking — the harn"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ess log names what is missing (`provider-usage: this dsh provides no …`, see `src/host-seams.ts`), a"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"nd the `compat` workflow replays the gate against the `latest` and `next` release lines daily, so dr"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"ift surfaces in CI rather than in your panel."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- **Host half** (`src/index.ts`): `UsageService extends TypertRemoteService` exposes `usage/list` vi"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"a the `Remote('list')` marker, applied without decorator syntax (SRC mode, no codegen). Config is de"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"clared with schemastery, and the settings provider's `installSection` enables hot updates from the s"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"ettings document.
- **Client half** (`src/client/`): a `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({id, factory})`"},{"id":"p27s5","text":" bundle (built by tsdown) mounts through the `sidebar.footer.action` slot (used purely as a mount po"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"int — the trigger itself is a floating ball portaled to `document.body`) and polls `usage/list` thro"},{"id":"p27s7","text":"ugh `ctx.connection.rpc.call('/api', 'usage/list', {args:{}})` on its own interval. The service stay"},{"id":"p27s8","text":"s stateless — every poll fetches live values."}],"truncated":true}
